Factsheet

Platforms:
PC (Windows)

Description

Explore the depths of the sea while collecting gems for adorable critters on your way down in this cozy incremental adventure.

History

We are three passionate developers from Québec who wanted to share our vision with the world. After many years of doing small projects, we finally put the time and effort to do a game from start to finish! The process has been a great experience and we are grateful for all feedback!

Features

  • Cozy Incremental Gameplay: Break underwater rocks and collect gems in a relaxing, stress-free adventure.
  • Explore 20 Ocean Depths: Dive deeper into the sea, progressing through 20 unique depths on your journey to the ocean floor.
  • 150+ Unlockable Upgrades: Develop your abilities through an extensive skill tree featuring multiple upgrade levels.
  • 5 Weapons - 6 Currencies: Discover different weapons and manage unique currencies to enhance your progression.
  • Meet Adorable Sea Creatures: Help underwater inhabitants, make friends, and uncover a lighthearted story as you clear each depth.
  • Charming Pixel-Art Adventure: Enjoy colorful 2D visuals, cute characters, and satisfying progression in a single-player experience.
